test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Utmost
solution:
The correct answer is: **Greatest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Utmost **means the greatest or highest degree of something. (किसी चीज़ की सबसे बड़ी या उच्चतम डिग्री)

 
 
• **For example**: *She gave her utmost effort to win the race.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Greatest **means large in amount, degree, size, etc.; a lot of. (मात्रा, आकार आदि में बड़ा; बहुत अधिक) 
 
 
• **For example**: *The greatest achievement is to overcome oneself.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Good**, is not a synonym of utmost. Good means satisfactory or adequate. (संतोषजनक या पर्याप्त)
 
• **Minimal**, is an antonym of utmost. Minimal means the least amount or degree. (सबसे कम मात्रा या डिग्री)
 
• **Least**, is an antonym of utmost. Least means the smallest amount or degree. (सबसे छोटी मात्रा)
